mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying clear skies and seventy-four degrees near Verona Area High School, though it feels a bit warmer at seventy-eight. Tonight features a first quarter moon, and if you look up at ten twenty-one PM, you can catch the Space Station passing high in the sky, heading from Middleton in the northwest toward Oregon and Fitchburg in the southeast.

In city news, Verona is highlighting its public access channel, VHAT, which provides live local government meetings and community features on Spectrum channel nine eighty-nine and YouTube. Also, residents are encouraged to try home composting or utilize the free Food Scrap Stop at Badger Prairie County Park to divert organic waste from the Dane County landfill.

There is plenty happening in the area this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness on July twentieth. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company on Tuesday, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, and the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park this Thursday.

In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Wednesday, July fifteenth, on Prairie Oaks Drive. A thirty-year-old Verona man was arrested for felony bail jumping after violating the conditions of his previous bond.

Finally, wrap up your day with a trip to Culver's for today's delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor of the day. They are open for another two hours until ten PM, so there is still plenty of time to drive over. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist.
